page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, supported by 64.0 GB of system memory, which translates to 8.0 GB of RAM per core. A key hardware feature is the inclusion of 1919 GB of local SSD storage, alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The CPU supports AVX, AVX512F, AES, and FMA instructions, but lacks newer vector neural network or matrix extensions.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.i2ne.2xlarge delivers modest compute capabilities. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests, such as stress-ng and Geekbench, place the instance in the bottom 25% tier. Memory bandwidth for small, cached blocks is weak, though large-block uncached read and write operations achieve average performance at 39.32 GB/sec and 35.72 GB/sec respectively. Redis SET operations perform at an average level with 6.02 million operations per second, whereas static web serving and database operations score in the lower percentiles.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server offers high resource density specifically in terms of local SSD storage and memory capacity relative to its compute power. It is well-suited for storage-intensive workloads, local database hosting, caching layers like Redis, and general-purpose applications that require a large local storage footprint but do not demand intensive CPU processing.
